newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, IMF in final talks on new loan - agency.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, IMF in final talks on new loan - agency.

text.p: Croatia began final talks with an Internal Monetary Fund (IMF) mission on a proposed three-year programme of financial support for its economic reforms, Croatian news agency HINA said on Monday.
Quoting a statement by the central bank, it said the negotiations on an extended fund facility (EFF) should be completed early next week.
A previous 18-month stand-by arrangement with the IMF to back basic stabilisation efforts in Croatia expired this spring.
The new arrangement would cover deeper structural reforms in the economy including the banking overhaul.
Apart from the central bank, HINA said the mission would also meet top government officials and representatives of other institutions. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
